source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal tek bir kötü-durum deyişine bağlıdır. Kaynak anlatımı, kişinin geceyi kötü bir durumda geçirmesini ve deyişteki durum adının olma kökünden açıklanmasını birlikte verir.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynak bildirimi kullanımı kötü durumda gece geçirme deyişiyle sınırlar.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök kümesi, olma ve bulunma çevresinden yer, konum değeri, birini üstlenme, boyun eğme, yaşlılık nitelemesi ve kötü durum adı gibi ayrışmış dallar kurar.

text.arabic_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ نُرِيدُ أَن نَّأْكُلَ مِنْهَا وَتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُنَا وَنَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ صَدَقْتَنَا وَنَكُونَ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ

baseline.text: Onlar, 'Ondan yemek, kalplerimizin güven bulması, bize doğru söylediğini bilmek ve ona tanık olanlardan olmak istiyoruz' dediler.

activation_trace.role: Literal ingestion supplies bodily contact with the object and starts the evidentiary chain.
Stillness and reassurance mark the inward stabilization produced by that contact.
Disclosure to the knower turns reassurance into an asserted epistemic result.
Fulfillment in action makes the spoken promise materially verifiable.
Presence with observation grounds the group's qualification as witnesses.
Knowledge-bearing declaration converts private certainty into a public evidentiary role.

changed_reading.after: They seek embodied participation that converts an external promise into settled knowledge and then accountable testimony.
changed_reading.before: They want food, emotional reassurance, and confirmation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated chain نأكل منها، تطمئن قلوبنا، نعلم، صدقتنا، نكون من الشاهدين moves from eating through inward settlement and knowledge to witnesshood.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ingestion gives the group bodily participation in an external event; that contact settles the inward core, discloses the addressee's enacted truth, and qualifies the group to issue knowledge-bearing testimony.

activation_trace.role: Back-and-forth movement supplies a branch-distant image of desire as unresolved searching.
Turning or reversal makes the heart the unstable element that requires arrest.
Stillness supplies the counter-motion that ends the heart's oscillation.
Solidity and straightness give the verified claim mechanical firmness.
Occurrence and presence complete the transition as an actual witness-state.

changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a transition from searching and inner reversal to a firm, present social standing as witnesses.
changed_reading.before: Their hearts merely need psychological reassurance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نريد, تطمئن, قلوبنا, صدقتنا, and نكون form a branch-level sequence from restless pursuit and turning to stillness, solidity, and realized state.
baseline_models.mechanism: The wish begins as searching movement around an unsettled, turning core. Eating is the hinge by which truth becomes firm and the group passes from oscillation into a stable witnessed condition.

activation_trace.role: Literal eating is the focus action whose value is revised by the earlier food frame.
Goodness opposed to impurity supplies a qualitative boundary for what may be consumed.
Release from prohibition makes consumability an authorized relation rather than mere access.
The eaten share as provision links ingestion to receiving an assigned benefit.
Apportioned giving casts the meal as a received allotment that can evidence its giver.

changed_reading.after: Eating receives an authorized, apportioned good whose status as gift and permission participates in the proof.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening food frame makes eating a governed reception of what has been released from prohibition, distinguished as good, and allotted as provision. The focus meal therefore tests more than physical availability: its edible share is received within an order of permission and gift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permitted goodness, released prohibition, and apportioned provision; I infer that this earlier food frame governs the later meal, while a live alternative is simple thematic recurrence.
structural_cues: 5:87-88 move from forbidding permitted good things to an imperative to eat provision; 5:113 reprises partitive eating from a supplied object.
The food sequence repeatedly couples consumption with moral qualification rather than treating appetite as self-authorizing.

activation_trace.role: Intentional willing starts the focus group's declared sequence of desired effects.
Intentional willing also starts the contrasting destructive sequence.
Causing something to fall and become fixed supplies the harmful sequence's first realized effect.
Turning away and obstruction supply the destructive sequence's terminal function.
Settling supplies the focus desire's opposed inward effect.
Knowledge-bearing testimony supplies the focus desire's opposed public endpoint.

changed_reading.after: Their wish is a disclosed causal program whose moral intelligibility lies in its movement toward settled knowledge and public testimony rather than division and obstruction.
changed_reading.before: Their stated wish is a neutral list of motives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same desire-root launches two opposed causal programs. In 5:91 desire aims to make division take hold and to block remembrance; in 5:113 desire openly aims at nourishment, settled hearts, knowledge, and witnesshood. Desire is evaluated by the effects it seeks to produce.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated desire-root and both consequence chains; I infer a deliberate outcome-based contrast, while the alternative is that the repetition is only a broad lexical echo.
structural_cues: 5:91 and 5:113 repeat the same finite desire construction and then enumerate sharply opposed consequences.
Both sequences move from an inward intention to social and ritual outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Direct consumption supplies the materially accessible encounter the group treats as evidence.
Disclosure to the group is their stated direction of knowledge.
A test that makes the subject's condition appear reverses the observer and observed roles.
Disclosure here is directed toward exposing who responds rightly to the test.
Temporal afterness makes response following disclosure a distinct accountable phase.
Punitive pain supplies the consequence attached to failing after the revealing encounter.
Testimony becomes the group's observable response to having received disclosure.

changed_reading.after: The meal also tests and reveals what kind of witnesses the eaters become after certainty is granted.
changed_reading.before: The group uses the meal to test whether the messenger's claim is true.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reachable game of 5:94 is a material test that reveals the agent's hidden response and carries consequences afterward. This reverses the focus group's proposed epistemic arrow: they want an accessible object so they can know, but an accessible object can simultaneously expose them as the ones being tested.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reachable material, a test that reveals condition, and the focus request to know by eating; I supply the reversal that the same event tests the eaters, while the alternative keeps the two episodes as independent examples of knowledge.
structural_cues: 5:94 places the tested object within reach of hands and spears, while 5:113 seeks an object within reach of ingestion.
5:94 explicitly joins material access, revealed response, and an after-phase of consequence.

activation_trace.role: The group's desired disclosure is the epistemic gain whose cost is re-evaluated.
Their proposed declaration by knowledge names the duty created after disclosure.
Repeated asking supplies the request mechanism that can force a consequential disclosure.
Sending something down makes disclosure an arriving object or message rather than an abstraction.
Earlier asking supplies the precedent that links request to a later failed response.
Blocking or covering recognized truth supplies the failed post-disclosure response.
Requested delivery from above concretely resumes the earlier disclosure pattern.
A manifest marker gives the descended meal explicit evidentiary status.
Covering a received favor names the failure made possible after the meal is granted.
Repeated punitive action supplies the exceptional liability attached to post-sign rejection.

changed_reading.after: Requested evidence creates a witnessed obligation: once knowledge is granted, later concealment of the sign becomes more, not less, consequential.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning about requested disclosure becoming a site of rejection is replayed around the requested descent of the table. Once the descended object is designated a visible sign, the focus group's desired knowledge and witnesshood become a threshold into heightened post-sign responsibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two request-disclosure-response sequences; I infer that the earlier warning places the focus motives under accountability, while the alternative is a general caution that does not specifically judge this request.
structural_cues: 5:101-102 sequence asking, disclosure, and rejection; 5:112-115 sequence requested descent, sign, descent granted, and punishment for rejection afterward.
5:113 occupies the hinge between request and grant and explicitly names both knowledge and future witnesshood.

activation_trace.role: Truth of speech supplies the proposition the group claims it will be able to attest.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the focus group's proposed public office.
The two testimony occurrences frame declaration by knowledge as a regulated obligation that must not be concealed.
Bringing testimony correctly supplies the procedural standard for the later witness claim.
Rejection or return of a defective claim supplies external contestability.
The paired oath occurrences supply solemn reinforcement and the possibility of counter-oath.

changed_reading.after: They undertake a contestable, truth-bound testimony concerning the sign and become accountable for presenting it faithfully.
changed_reading.before: They promise to report that they saw an extraordinary meal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding witness procedure treats testimony as a regulated truth-bearing act: it can compete with another testimony, must be brought on its proper face, is reinforced by oaths, and can be returned. The focus pledge therefore sounds like self-enrollment into an accountable evidentiary office.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a dense legal testimony procedure near the focus and repeats the same witness-root; I infer that it colors the later noun, while ordinary eyewitnessing remains a live alternative.
structural_cues: 5:106-108 repeatedly regulate testimony, competing witnesses, oaths, proper presentation, and reversal shortly before the table scene.
The focus phrase عليها من الشاهدين assigns a relation to a specific evidentiary object rather than merely reporting amazement.

activation_trace.role: Coming into an actual state establishes the group as witnesses.
Knowledge-bearing declaration supplies the social role that can carry the event beyond consumption.
A food-bearing platter supplies the concrete communal object around which memory can organize.
Coming into a realized condition establishes the table-event in a continuing communal function.
A feast whose condition returns supplies recurrence rather than a one-time meal.
A visible marker gives the recurring meal an enduring evidentiary function.
The paired giving language makes the event a received allotment whose source is part of what is remembered.

changed_reading.after: The cohort is constituted around a provisioned sign whose recurring communal memory can connect first and last.
changed_reading.before: A present cohort witnesses a single event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah asks that the food-bearing table become a recurring feast for first and last, a manifest sign, and provision. Its becoming and the group's becoming witnesses are parallel constitutions: one object is established as a repeatable communal marker, and one cohort is established to carry its attestation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel becoming clauses and a feast for first and last; I infer that witnesses mediate the sign's communal duration, while the alternative limits the feast language to celebration without a transgenerational witness office.
structural_cues: 5:113 says نكون witnesses; 5:114 answers with تكون a feast for first and last.
5:114 coordinates recurring feast, visible sign, and provision in one requested function.

activation_trace.role: Ingestion supplies direct participation in the event that bounds what this group can attest.
Disclosure supplies the limited knowledge acquired through that participation.
Presence with observation anchors the scope of the group's witnesshood.
The contrast between denied creaturely knowledge and complete divine knowing supplies an epistemic limit.
The four knowledge occurrences distinguish known speech, inner knowledge, denied reciprocity, and exhaustive divine knowledge.
The two witness occurrences contrast temporally bounded human presence with unrestricted divine presence.
Taking the person away supplies the temporal break that ends direct human observation.
Guarding surveillance supplies the function that continues after the human witness departs.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the final outcome by which testimony's truthfulness matters.
The truthful persons and their truth make accuracy a lived quality with final utility.

changed_reading.after: Direct participation grants a sharply bounded duty to tell the truth about what they actually came to know, with the value of that witness measured by enduring truthfulness.
changed_reading.before: Direct proof grants the group broad authority as witnesses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The judgment scenes delimit created knowledge and testimony. Messengers disclaim unbounded knowledge; Jesus' witnesshood lasts while he is present, then surveillance and universal witness belong to God; finally truthfulness is what benefits. Eating, knowing, and witnessing in the focus therefore form a bounded qualification by direct participation, not an unlimited authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit limits on created knowledge and presence plus the final benefit of truth; I infer that eating qualifies this group only for event-bounded testimony, while a live alternative hears their witnesshood as a general devotional profession.
structural_cues: 5:109 denies the messengers unbounded knowledge; 5:116-117 repeatedly delimit speech, knowledge, presence, and witnesshood.
5:117 explicitly marks witnesshood as lasting only while the witness remains among the observed, and 5:119 makes truth beneficial.

remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which the earlier food regulations directly frame the table episode, rather than supplying thematic recurrence, remains open.
The recurring feast can sustain a transgenerational witness-community, but it may denote celebration without assigning later participants an evidentiary office.
The moving-table and return-resistant testimony readings depend on branch-distant activations and should remain exploratory.
strongest_changes: The food-law frame turns eating into receipt of permitted, allotted provision rather than appetite or brute sensory proof alone.
The reachable-game test reverses the epistemic arrow: the material object also exposes and tests the eater.
The question, testimony, and descent sequences turn certainty into accountable witnesshood with post-sign consequences.
The continuation makes the event a recurring communal sign while limiting created witnesses to present knowledge and durable truthfulness.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah contains an unusually explicit causal ladder from ingestion to inward settlement, knowledge, verified fulfillment, and public witnesshood. Context activates both institutional mechanisms, such as lawful provision and testimony, and a contained material mechanics of motion, turning, stillness, and solidity.

activation_trace.role: Stillness supplies the arresting force in the exploratory counter-motion.
Turning and reversal make the inward core the moving element to be stabilized.
Solidity gives verified truth the firm state reached after settlement.
Motion and oscillation supply the strange contextual counter-image to inward stillness.
The food-bearing platter keeps that motion image attached to the actual meal rather than an independent theme.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, contact with the table converts a field of motion and inner reversal into stillness and solid truth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the table-root's motion branch beside its ordinary platter branch and reads the heart through a reversal branch. It remains anchored in the focus stillness, heart, eating, and solidity sequence plus the named table in 5:112 and 5:114. Render it only as exploratory lexical mechanics, not as a claim that the table physically oscillated.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تطمئن قلوبنا places stillness directly on hearts after eating, while صدقتنا can carry solidity; the context names the eaten object with the table-root.

activation_trace.role: The secondary rejection branch shadows desire with concern that a claim may fail acceptance.
Literal ingestion supplies embodied evidence that could make later testimony harder to dismiss.
Declaration by knowledge is the claim exposed to acceptance or rejection.
Properly presented testimony supplies the nearby standard against which the focus pledge is heard.
Return or nonacceptance makes evidentiary rejection an explicit contextual possibility.
The paired oaths show how testimony may be reinforced yet still challenged.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they want embodied evidence that can support testimony against later return, rejection, or counterclaim.
changed_reading.before: They want enough proof to feel certain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's secondary ر د د mapping under the focus desire-root and the nearby rule about returned oaths. It remains valid as an activation because focus desire culminates in testimony and 5:108 explicitly makes testimony contestable. Render it as a shadow reading about resistance to rejection, never as the lexical meaning of نريد.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نريد begins a chain ending in نكون عليها من الشاهدين, allowing the focus desire to be pressured by the secondary return-or-rejection branch and the nearby testimony procedure.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Ingestion is asked to settle the inward ground.** `ء ك ل B001` is ingestion, `ط م ن B001` settling into calm, `B002` low ground, and `ق ل ب B001` the inward faculty. I infer that food descending into bodies is expected to make the heart a low, stable basin where turbulent doubt can settle.
2. **Private calm seeks conversion into testimony.** `ص د ق B004` is confirmation and `ش ه د B001` present witnessing. The stated sequence is eat–settle–know–witness. I infer that material experience is requested as a bridge from received claim to public evidence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Consumption is meant to settle inward unrest and produce outward evidence.** Fixed **ط م ن / B001** (“settling into calm”) assigns the table a heart-level role, while eating, knowing, confirmation, and witness form the supplied sequence. 5:111 had already recorded belief; 5:112 requested a visible table, and 5:114 turns it into sign, provision, and recurring occasion. I infer that ingesting the sign is expected to move certainty from external report into bodily assurance, then back outward as testimony. The request reads as an evidentiary circuit through body and heart, not hunger alone.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:114 expanded the desired calm into communal memory, while 5:115 made that remembered, witnessed provision a heightened accountability threshold.

words.gloss_range: completed plural speech introducing the disciples' reply
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) is more than a dialogue tag: the perfect plural verb closes the prior challenge in 5:112 and opens a completed collective reply. The plural ending recovers the disciples without renaming them, and the speech frame makes their motives publicly accountable before the four desired outcomes unfold. Its speech-plus-heart-settling pattern also recalls 2:260, so the reply sits within a faith seeking experiential confirmation pattern without losing its local dialogue role.
words.root_gloss_range: saying, articulated speech, declaration, and verbal response; locally a direct reported-speech frame

topics.headline: completed plural reply frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah as a completed plural answer to the challenge in 5:112, not as a free-standing food request.
topics.reason: The perfect plural speech verb opens the quoted unit and reverses the prior singular prophetic voice into a collective disciple reply.

topics.headline: speech makes motive accountable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disciples explain their motives in speech before the desired outcomes are listed.
topics.reason: The q-w-l speech frame externalizes inner desire and contains the four-purpose explanation.

topics.headline: speech echo and confirmation pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the reply within a local and cross-passage pattern of speech seeking confirmation, especially 2:260.
topics.reason: The parallels are real as echoes and framing patterns, but they do not override the local function as a dialogue-opening verb.

words.gloss_range: present collective wanting directed into a four-part purpose chain
words.prose: {{ar:نُرِيدُ}} ({{tr:nurīdu}}) keeps the disciples' desire present inside the narrated speech. One Form IV volition verb governs the whole body-heart-mind-witness ladder, so their wanting is not vague appetite but directed pursuit toward confirmation.
words.root_gloss_range: seeking, going after, wanting, intending, and willing; locally Form IV volition, with seeking pressure kept as color

topics.headline: present collective desire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the disciples' wanting as ongoing at the speech moment and collectively owned.
topics.reason: The imperfect first plural form preserves present volition inside the reported speech.

topics.headline: one verb governs four outcomes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one desire organizes eating, heart-rest, knowledge, and witnesshood into a single ladder.
topics.reason: The following content complex is governed by the one volition verb rather than by four independent wishes.

topics.headline: seeking becomes directed will
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels desire as active seeking toward confirmation, while the local Form IV keeps wanting as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root's movement field survives as pressure, but local morphology and syntax select volition rather than physical roaming.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive/content particle opening the desired outcomes
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) turns the wanting into projected content and places the first verb in the subjunctive. Its scope holds the coordinated outcomes together, while the later particle at word 11 shows that the repeated form can do different work in the same ayah. The nasal contact with the following n-prefixed verb lets the dependency be heard as the purpose chain begins.

topics.headline: one particle projects the purpose chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees all four outcomes as projected under desire, not as already achieved.
topics.reason: The particle directly governs the first subjunctive and extends through coordination across the chain.

topics.headline: first particle contrasts with later content marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader learns not to flatten the two matching particle forms into identical function.
topics.reason: The later particle frames a proposition, while this first one projects desired action.

topics.headline: nasal contact binds particle and verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the particle cling to the first governed verb as the desire begins to unfold.
topics.reason: The written separation and recitational contact both mark dependency on the following verb.

words.gloss_range: literal requested eating from the table, not total consumption
words.prose: {{ar:نَّأْكُلَ}} ({{tr:naʾkula}}) begins the desired outcomes with literal bodily participation: the disciples want to eat from the table, not merely inspect it. The subjunctive keeps the eating unrealized, while the following from-it phrase narrows the root's wider consumption field to partaking from a sign whose result will be heart-rest, knowledge, and testimony.
words.root_gloss_range: eating, consuming, devouring, and corroding; locally narrowed to embodied partaking from a divine table-sign

topics.headline: partaking from the table
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the request begins with embodied partaking from a sign, while the partitive phrase blocks total consumption or metaphorical devouring.
topics.reason: The root range includes wider consumption branches, but the table referent and from-it complement select literal partaking.

topics.headline: subjunctive collective eating
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the disciples as active participants in a requested event that has not yet happened.
topics.reason: The subjunctive mood and first plural verbal form keep eating projected and participatory.

topics.headline: body opens the certainty ladder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees bodily intake as the first stage of verification before heart, mind, and testimony.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect the first purpose to proof logic and to the ordered body-heart-mind-role sequence.

words.gloss_range: partitive from-it phrase referring back to the table
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهَا}} ({{tr:minhā}}) makes the table the source of a portion, not an object exhausted by consumption. The feminine suffix carries the table from 5:112 into the first purpose and prepares its return in the later upon-it phrase, where the same referent becomes the object of testimony.

topics.headline: portion from the table
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the table remains a source of received evidence rather than an object consumed away.
topics.reason: The preposition attaches to eating as a partitive source relation.

topics.headline: suffix carries the table from 5:112
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same table from the prior ayah into the first desired act without a repeated noun.
topics.reason: The feminine suffix resolves to the table introduced in 5:112.

topics.headline: from-it prepares upon-it
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the table frame the chain as both source of eating and object of testimony.
topics.reason: The same feminine suffix returns in the final witness phrase, forming an internal frame.

words.gloss_range: connector adding heart-rest to the same desire chain
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds heart-rest to the same desired chain as eating. It can carry a circumstantial shade, but the local coordination keeps the following settling verb as a real second outcome and starts the repeated connector rhythm that will lead toward knowledge and witnesshood.

topics.headline: heart-rest joined to eating
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that eating alone is not enough; heart-rest is added as a connected desired outcome.
topics.reason: The connector links the second subjunctive clause to the same desired sequence.

topics.headline: coordination with circumstantial shade
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel heart-rest as closely accompanying eating, while local syntax still preserves it as a coordinated purpose.
topics.reason: A circumstantial reading is possible as shade, but the chain structure supports coordination.

topics.headline: first repeated ladder connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first step in the repeated connector rhythm that builds the four-purpose ladder.
topics.reason: The repeated connector at words 6, 9, and 14 creates audible and structural progression.

words.gloss_range: desired heart-settling after agitation, not present rest already possessed
words.prose: {{ar:تَطْمَئِنَّ}} ({{tr:taṭmaʾinna}}) names the requested movement from agitation into settled safety. Its feminine singular agreement ties it to the broken-plural hearts, its subjunctive mood keeps the rest desired rather than already possessed, and its rare heart-settling speech pattern recalls the experiential-confirmation scene of 2:260. The emphatic opening, nasal texture, internal hamza, and final doubled nūn let the sound slow, catch, and land with the meaning of settling.
words.root_gloss_range: settling, stillness, calm, reassurance, and security; locally heart-rest selected by the following heart subject

topics.headline: subjunctive heart-rest
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees tranquility as a requested outcome of the table-event, not a present possession.
topics.reason: The verb is coordinated into the subjunctive chain and has its own subject.

topics.headline: settling after instability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels tranquility as motion coming to rest after faith-pressure, not as a vague calm mood.
topics.reason: The root evidence and local heart subject select stillness after agitation.

topics.headline: experiential confirmation echo with 2:260
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the disciples' request as part of the faith-seeking-experience pattern seen in 2:260.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence evidence gives the concrete 2:260 parallel and a rare speech-plus-heart-settling pattern.

topics.headline: sound shape enacts settling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the consonant texture slow and land with the meaning of settling.
topics.reason: The quadriliteral form and recitational texture support the semantic landing without replacing the local sense.

words.gloss_range: our broken-plural hearts as the subject of settling
words.prose: {{ar:قُلُوبُنَا}} ({{tr:qulūbunā}}) reveals whose inner centers must settle. The broken plural and possessive suffix make the request communal yet distributed, while the turning-root pressure makes the heart-rest concrete: the organs named for turning are asked to stop turning. Against same-surah hearts marked by disease or fear at 5:41 and 5:52, these are hearts seeking stabilization through confirmation.
words.root_gloss_range: turning, flipping, changing, heart, and inner core; locally the turning inner centers that seek stillness

topics.headline: hearts do the settling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hearts themselves are the grammatical subject of settling.
topics.reason: The broken plural subject licenses feminine singular agreement and makes the hearts the internal actors.

topics.headline: our multiple inner centers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a communal request distributed across many possessed hearts rather than an abstract heart proverb.
topics.reason: The broken plural and first-person possessive suffix specify the disciples' own inner centers.

topics.headline: turning hearts seek stillness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands why settling is needed: the heart-word carries a turning image, while local context selects inner centers, not generic flipping.
topics.reason: The turning root remains a meaningful image but is narrowed by the noun's local heart sense.

topics.headline: same-surah heart diagnostic redirected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this heart mention as a positive redirection of the surah's heart-diagnostic field.
topics.reason: The same-surah rows contrast diseased or fearful hearts with hearts seeking stabilization here.

words.gloss_range: connector moving the chain from heart-rest to knowing
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the knowledge clause inside the same equal-rank purpose chain. Its position makes the movement legible: after bodily partaking and heart-settling, the reply pivots into cognition rather than stopping at emotion. As the second repeated connector, it also gives the ladder another audible beat before the final witness clause.

topics.headline: knowledge stays in the chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees knowing as another coordinated desired outcome, not a new independent assertion.
topics.reason: The connector preserves equal syntactic rank under the first purpose particle.

topics.headline: connector moves from heart to mind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the epistemic ladder turning from inner settling toward cognition.
topics.reason: The connector sits exactly between the heart clause and the knowledge verb.

topics.headline: second ladder beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated short connector as a patterned step in the ascent.
topics.reason: The same connector form recurs at the major clause transitions.

words.gloss_range: active desired knowing of a verified truth proposition
words.prose: {{ar:نَعْلَمَ}} ({{tr:naʿlama}}) asks for active experiential knowing, not bare information. The verb takes the proposition opened by the following content particle, and the qiraat pressure around person and passivity shows how strongly the base reading keeps the disciples as the knowers seeking certainty.
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, recognizing, learning, and marking; locally experiential certainty about the truth claim

topics.headline: disciples seek active certainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the base reading assign knowing to the disciples as active seekers of certainty.
topics.reason: The first plural active base reading contrasts with passive or second-person variants.

topics.headline: knowledge has a verified payload
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the desired knowledge is precise: the truthfulness proposition, not knowledge in general.
topics.reason: The verb takes the following content clause as its object.

topics.headline: knowing by sign recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees knowledge as experiential recognition through the table-event, while the local verb remains cognition rather than a separate mark noun.
topics.reason: The mark/sign field sharpens the epistemic force but does not replace the selected knowing sense.

topics.headline: qiraat exposes movable knower role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how person and voice variants would reassign epistemic responsibility.
topics.reason: Accepted variant evidence is useful for contrast, while the base reading governs the local parse.

words.gloss_range: content particle framing the truth proposition known
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) is the second particle-form in the ayah, but here it frames the content known rather than governing the first purpose. Its possible declarative or infinitival analyses both move toward the same point once the verification particle follows: verified truthfulness is the object of knowledge.

topics.headline: second particle frames proposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second particle as routing knowledge to a proposition, unlike the first particle that projected action.
topics.reason: The following perfect construction is content of knowing rather than a subjunctive action governed by the particle.

topics.headline: parse ambiguity steered by verification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a grammatical fork, but both analyses are pulled toward verified truthfulness by the following particle.
topics.reason: The lightened-affirmation and infinitival analyses remain meaningful without changing the local truth-proposition endpoint.

topics.headline: repeated form changes function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees same surface form doing changed work inside one ayah.
topics.reason: The local reprise separates purpose projection from proposition framing.

words.gloss_range: verification particle scoping over the perfect truth verb
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) places verification pressure inside an unrealized desire clause. It scopes over the perfect truth verb, so the disciples ask to know as settled fact what the grammar already frames as completed truth. That verification pressure answers the prior conditional challenge and joins the wider truth-certainty field of the ʿĪsā passage, including 5:116 and 5:119.

topics.headline: verification scopes over truth verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the truth claim framed as completed and verified inside a desire for knowledge.
topics.reason: The particle directly precedes and scopes over the perfect truth verb.

topics.headline: conditional pressure answered by certainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the previous ayah's faith-pressure answered by a particle of verification.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect the particle to the prior conditional challenge.

topics.headline: local truth-certainty field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this verification particle as part of the wider ʿĪsā-passage truth-certainty field, including 5:116 and 5:119.
topics.reason: The same-surah evidence gives concrete later truth-certainty links.

words.gloss_range: you have been truthful to us, with direct interpersonal object marking
words.prose: {{ar:صَدَقْتَنَا}} ({{tr:ṣadaqtanā}}) gives the knowledge clause its payload: direct truthfulness from ʿĪsā to the disciples. The Form I perfect keeps the focus on his truthfulness itself, not on the disciples as validators, and the fused subject-object marking makes the truth relation interpersonal. The truth root also carries firmness pressure here: what they seek to know is stable enough to settle hearts and ground witnesshood, so the request reverses hostile truth-challenge formulas into confirmation rather than denial.
words.root_gloss_range: truthfulness, sincerity, correctness, fulfillment, and firmness; locally the prophet's truthfulness to the disciples

topics.headline: you-to-us truth relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees truthfulness as an interpersonal relation between ʿĪsā and the disciples.
topics.reason: The morphology encodes second-person masculine subject and first-person plural object in one verb.

topics.headline: perfect truth inside future desire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what remains future is their knowing, not ʿĪsā's truthfulness.
topics.reason: The perfect verb sits inside the larger subjunctive desire chain.

topics.headline: truth as firm support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels truthfulness as something firm enough to ground heart-rest and witnesshood, while the local sense remains truthful speech to them.
topics.reason: The firmness image survives as lexical pressure, but local grammar selects truthfulness to the disciples.

topics.headline: challenge formula becomes confirmation request
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the request as confirmation of truthfulness, not hostile denial.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect the truth root to challenge formulas and the 5:112 boundary.

words.gloss_range: connector adding the final witness-role purpose
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the final purpose without breaking the chain. The same connector pattern now moves private knowing into public role, so witnesshood is not an afterthought but the coordinated climax. As the third connector in the triad, it completes the audible stepping rhythm of the purpose chain.

topics.headline: final clause remains equal-rank
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees witnesshood as a coordinated desired outcome, not a detached afterthought.
topics.reason: The connector adds the final subjunctive clause to the same chain.

topics.headline: connector moves certainty outward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices private knowledge being carried into public witness identity.
topics.reason: The final connector introduces the witness landing after the knowledge clause.

topics.headline: third connector completes cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the connective triad complete the progression.
topics.reason: The proclitic connector repeats the pattern from words 6 and 9.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive becoming into a witness category
words.prose: {{ar:نَكُونَ}} ({{tr:nakūna}}) turns certainty into role-entry. The membership predicate selects becoming among a witness class, so the being-root becomes role-emergence: witnesshood comes into being in the disciples. Qiraat contrast shows that the base reading assigns that testimonial role to the disciples rather than shifting it to ʿĪsā.
words.root_gloss_range: being, existing, happening, and coming into being; locally becoming or entering a role

topics.headline: becoming among witnesses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final verb as role-entry into a witness class, not bare existence.
topics.reason: The predicate with membership preposition selects becoming among witnesses.

topics.headline: being-root as role emergence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels witnesshood coming into being in the disciples, while local syntax narrows the broad being-root to role transition.
topics.reason: The root's ontological field survives as role-emergence under the local predicate.

topics.headline: variant can reassign witness role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a person change would move the testimonial role, while the base reading keeps it with the disciples.
topics.reason: Variant evidence exposes role sensitivity without governing the canonical parse.

topics.headline: becoming bridges knowing to witnesshood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final verb as the hinge that turns knowledge into witness identity.
topics.reason: The k-w-n plus sh-h-d pairing and local position both support category-entry closure.

words.gloss_range: upon/concerning-it phrase binding testimony back to the table
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهَا}} ({{tr:ʿalayhā}}) brings the table back before the witness class. Whether the phrase leans toward the act of becoming or toward the witness noun, its fronted position makes the table-event the object over or concerning which their witness identity is defined.

topics.headline: same table returns as testimony object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the table from source of eating to object of testimony.
topics.reason: The feminine suffix resumes the same table referent already carried by the earlier from-it phrase.

topics.headline: act or identity attachment pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the phrase can lean toward becoming or toward witnesses, but either way the table controls the final role.
topics.reason: Attachment ambiguity is meaningful but does not license a new referent or detach the phrase from the witness clause.

topics.headline: over and concerning remain live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both presence-over and testimony-concerning senses in view without flattening the preposition to location alone.
topics.reason: The witness context selects testimonial concern while spatial overtones remain locally useful.

topics.headline: upon-it foregrounds testimony object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the table-event placed before the witness class as the axis of identity.
topics.reason: The preposed preposition-suffix unit foregrounds relation and object together.

words.gloss_range: membership preposition placing them among the witnesses
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:minā}}) is membership, not source, unlike the earlier from-it phrase. It converts becoming into being counted among the witnesses, so the final clause asks for entry into a recognized category rather than a one-time act. The repeated preposition changes function from table-source to witness-membership.

topics.headline: among the witness class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the disciples asking to belong among witnesses, not to take something from witnesses.
topics.reason: The local preposition marks category membership with the definite plural predicate.

topics.headline: preposition converts becoming into category entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the small preposition doing the structural work that completes the copular predicate.
topics.reason: The preposition links the becoming verb to the witness category.

topics.headline: from-it becomes among-them contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated preposition change function from table-source to witness-membership.
topics.reason: The earlier from-it phrase and this membership phrase create a local contrast.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ}} ({{tr:ash-shāhidīn}}) lands the ayah in durable public attestation. The definite active participle names a known human witness class, joins presence with testimony, and closes the movement from speech to eating, heart-rest, knowledge, and accountable witnesshood. The formula also reaches beyond this scene, including witness-category language at 3:53 and 5:83 and the same-surah witness thread at 5:117.
words.root_gloss_range: being present, seeing, witnessing, testifying, and attesting; locally durable human witnesshood over the table-event

topics.headline: definite human witness category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees witnesshood as a known human category the disciples seek to enter.
topics.reason: The definite sound masculine active participle plural names a recognized rational witness class.

topics.headline: being there and attesting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that witnesshood includes direct presence at the table-event and later attestation about it.
topics.reason: The sh-h-d root evidence joins presence, seeing, and testimony in the local final noun.

topics.headline: participle makes witnesshood lasting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word as a continuing status, not a one-time verb of testifying.
topics.reason: The nominal active participle closes the ayah with durable agency.

topics.headline: formula spans communities and passage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the local witness role inside a recurring formula, including 3:53 and 5:83, and a same-surah witness thread at 5:117.
topics.reason: The supplied CRITICAL rows give concrete references for the witness-category formula and same-surah continuity.

topics.headline: speech closes as testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah move from opening speech to closing public attestation.
topics.reason: The final noun frames the whole utterance as speech becoming witnesshood.
